known.title: Handle paused history queries as an offline state

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a signed-in admin loses connectivity on Projects, then opens Change history for the first time. `useHistory` uses TanStack Query's default network mode; `main.tsx:10–13` does not override it. Offline queries remain pending with `fetchStatus: 'paused'`, so this line displays “Loading change history…” until connectivity returns, while the connection-error message and retry control never appear. This misses the required offline message explaining what to do next. Handle the paused state explicitly and cover this navigation in the browser flow. The pending/paused behavior is documented in [TanStack Query's network modes](https://tanstack.com/query/latest/docs/framework/react/guides/network-mode).
